newsitem.title: NIGERIA: New chief executive not yet named for Nigerian LNG.
newsitem.headline: New chief executive not yet named for Nigerian LNG.

text.p: The Nigerian liquefied natural gas (NLNG) company has yet to name a successor to its outgoing Dutch managing director Theo Oerlemans, a senior official of the company said on Wednesday.
He said local press reports saying a new chief executive had been appointed to succeed Oerlemans was not correct.

"The issue of successor to Mr Oerlemans is on the agenda of the company's board of directors meeting fixed for Thursday in Lagos," the official said, adding that it was expected that the board would name Oerlemans's successor after the meeting.

Oerlemans has completed his three-year term as head of the NLNG, which is constructing in southeastern Bonny town the $4 billion LNG project. It is expected to produce 7.2 billion cubic metres of gas per year from 1999.
